changes.summary: Filter chips (filterbuilder + pkg/filterq) on the remaining list screens: /notifications (unread, level, created date; ?unread=true becomes the unread chip), /account/sessions (created, expires, current session), /settings/sessions (user, status, created, expires; search kept, count and infinite scroll follow the filtered set), /settings/notifications/users (role, group, turned-off channel; ?q= search kept, saving keeps the view, Show more paging), /finance/inventory (currency, price, quantity, created date; search kept, CreatedAt.From/To links become a chip) and /finance/debt-aggregates (counterparty, currency, side, has outstanding; one row per counterparty and currency, so sums in different currencies are never added; the row drawer lists only the debts the row sums). session.Repository gains CountFound; RecipientQuery gains Filters; debt.Repository.GetCounterpartyAggregates takes optional filters. A page with filter chips restored from htmx history is reloaded, so Back always shows the URL's chips.
